Figure 1:When progress stalls, find a way forward.In a selected ObjectNav episode (navigate to an apple), policy sampling
fails at cost2323, while the local-robustness decoderRCDends early at cost33.VICS-Gbreaks the cycle of failed retries and reaches the goal at cost1111.
Circles mark the region of failed forward moves. All three incur safety
cost; the full trajectories and intervention trace appear in
AppendixA.

Figure 3:VICS-Gescapes the failed-action loop and completes the task.In ObjectNav (“navigate to an apple”), policy sampling accumulates cost
through failed retries and ends unsuccessfully at cost2323, whileRCDstops
early at cost33.VICS-Greplaces the marked actions, leaves the failure
region, and completes the task at cost1111.

Figure 4:VICS-Gpreserves task completion while the alternatives fail differently.From the same initial Fetch view,VICS-Gfinishes holding the target plant
at cost1212; policy sampling ends with the wrong object (a book) at cost1919, whileRCDends empty-handed at cost33. Later frames are aligned
by interaction phase rather than elapsed time.
